# BuildAWallet.xyz

Human wallet design: https://buildawallet.xyz/human
Read-only external-wallet mainnet balance view: https://buildawallet.xyz/human/live
Machine payment discovery: https://buildawallet.xyz/machine/info
Paid Base mainnet native balance: GET https://buildawallet.xyz/machine/wallet?address=0x...
Paid Solana mainnet SOL balance: GET https://buildawallet.xyz/machine/solana-wallet?address=...
These machine endpoints require a separate Cloudflare Worker deployment. Check /machine/info before assuming availability. Both accept $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana mainnet. BuildAWallet does not deploy agent wallets or offer production signing or broadcast.
